title: Graphic Designer
description:
Desired Candidate Profile: The Visualizer is responsible for leading high-quality visual design output across digital and print platforms. The role demands strong conceptual thinking, brand sensitivity, design craft, speed, and the ability to guide junior designers while ensuring consistent, campaign-ready work. The Visualizer will collaborate closely with Creative, Copy, Content/Strategy, and Account teams to translate briefs into compelling key visuals, campaign creatives, brand systems, and production-ready assets. 
 KEY RESULT AREAS (KRAs) & WEIGHTAGES 
 1. Creative Output & Quality 
 Ability to conceptualize and design high-impact visuals (KVs, campaign assets, social creatives, print collaterals) aligned to brand guidelines and campaign objectives. 
 2. Brand Consistency & Visual Systems 
 Ensure strong brand ownership through consistent typography, layout systems, grids, colour discipline, and template creation across ongoing accounts. 
 3. Timeliness, Productivity & Workflow Management 
 Efficiently plan and execute deliverables within timelines while maintaining clean file structures and production readiness. 
 ROLE EXPECTATIONS Core Responsibilities 
 Translate creative briefs into concept boards, key visuals, layouts, and production- ready creatives 
 Design social media creatives, ad systems, print collaterals, OOH adaptations, retail creatives, pitch decks Develop KV + adaptation ecosystems (master KV multi-format rollout across platforms) Ensure brand consistency across typography, composition, colour, and imagery Maintain organized editable files, export sets, and version control 
 SKILLS & TOOLS 
 Software: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign (bonus: After Effects basics), Figma Understanding: Layout systems, typography, grids, visual hierarchy, brand tonality, production specs (print + digital) Soft Skills: Communication, ownership, multitasking, mentoring, problem-solving, feedback handling Added Advantage: AI-assisted design workflows, mock-up/3D preview tools, basic motion sense for design-to-motion handoffs

Key Skills: Graphic Designing,Visualiser,Creative,Graphics,Design

title: ASIC Physical Design Engineer
description:
Description : 
 - Expertise in ASIC physical design

 - Expertise in full-chip implementation, bump placement, IP integration, and timing-driven PnR.

 - Expertise in clock tree synthesis, power/clock gating, scan stitching, and design optimization.

 - Expertise in floor planning, methodology setup, and signoff processes for large IPs.

 - Expertise in scripting (TCL, Python, Perl) for design flow automation.

 - Drive SOC-level floor planning, partitioning, and die size estimation.

 - Manage hierarchical design flows, including block-level pin placement and HFN implementation.

 - Lead clock planning strategies at SOC and subsystem levels (Mesh/Tree).

 - Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and cross-functional teams.

 - Own bump planning, including GPIO placement, pad ring generation, hard IP bump integration, and RDL routing.

 - Strong communication and problem-solving abilities

 - Collaborate with RTL, STA, and verification teams for design closure.

 - Utilize multiple EDA tools like Synopsys Fusion Compiler, ICC2, Design Compiler
